assumptions: The cap is declared on the ledger and treated as immutable; nothing here enforces immutability against a caller that rewrites it.
attrs.evidence: Property-tested at 2,000 trials as kernel law C10, plus boundary cases in the regression (under cap permitted, exactly on the cap permitted, over the cap refused).
attrs.statement: A declared cap bounds CUMULATIVE consumption of an irreversible resource: the sink balance never exceeds it, and a spend that would cross it is INFEASIBLE even when the account can afford it.
